item.title: Porter Robinson's Worlds Live, but Acoustic! Live @ Eon Night, March 2021
item.description: During the early days of the pandemic, I become obsessed with the music of Porter Robinson. Naturally, I started to arrange some of his songs for fingerstyle guitar. I grew even more enamoured with the audiovisual spectacle that is Worlds Live - the live show for the “Worlds” album era, where the songs from the album are remixed, extended and made so much more grandiose, paired with thematic visuals and lighting.
